description: Read your brand kit before you design, animate or write anything for your brand: its colors with their roles, its fonts (with a link to the font file when one was uploaded), light or dark as the usual look, how the brand sounds, and links to its logos and pictures ready to use. With no name it reads your default kit. When you have no kit it says so and how to make one; then keep the work brand neutral. Free and read only.

kit_id.description: Optional. The id of one of your kits, from list_brand_kits.

name.description: Optional. The name of one of your kits. Omit for your default kit.

name: get_brand_kit
title: Read Brand Kit
